in_marathi.name: Hirdesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Hari's path
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hirdesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hirdesh is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: Hira (Lord Vishnu) and Desh (domain or path). The name thus means 'Lord Hari's path' or 'the path to Lord Vishnu'. This name is believed to have been used in ancient Hindu texts and scriptures and is associated with devotion, spirituality, and a strong connection to the divine.
